title: AWS global infrastructure — concept map
intro: AWS runs in geographically isolated Regions. Each Region has multiple Availability Zones (AZs) in separate data centers. Edge locations and Regional Edge Caches sit closer to users for content delivery. Local Zones and Wavelength extend compute to metro areas and 5G networks. Choosing the right Region and AZ pair is the foundation for compliance, latency, and high availability.

overviewDiagram.title: AWS global infrastructure layers
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TB
  subgraph Global["Global layer"]
    R53[Route 53 DNS]
    CF[CloudFront CDN]
  end
  subgraph Region["AWS Region e.g. ap-south-1"]
    AZ1[Availability Zone a]
    AZ2[Availability Zone b]
    AZ3[Availability Zone c]
    LZ[Local Zone optional]
  end
  subgraph Edge["Edge network"]
    PoP[Edge PoP]
    REC[Regional Edge Cache]
  end
  U[Users worldwide] --> R53
  R53 --> CF
  CF --> PoP
  PoP --> REC
  REC -->|cache miss| Region
  U -->|API calls| Region
  LZ -.->|single-digit ms| U

conceptCards.title: Regions
conceptCards.summary: Fully isolated partitions. Pick for compliance, data residency, service availability, and latency to users.
conceptCards.example: Store EU customer PII only in eu-west-1 to satisfy GDPR residency expectations

conceptCards.title: Availability Zones
conceptCards.summary: Separate data centers within a Region with low-latency links. Spread stateful tiers across at least two AZs.
conceptCards.example: RDS Multi-AZ primary in ap-south-1a, standby in ap-south-1b

conceptCards.title: Edge locations
conceptCards.summary: CloudFront Points of Presence cache static assets near users. Regional Edge Caches sit between PoPs and origins.
conceptCards.example: React bundle served from Mumbai edge instead of us-east-1 S3

conceptCards.title: Local Zones & Wavelength
conceptCards.summary: Metro Local Zones cut latency to single-digit ms. Wavelength embeds compute at 5G carrier edge.
conceptCards.example: Real-time video analytics in Los Angeles Local Zone

conceptCards.title: Choosing Region + AZ
conceptCards.summary: Filter by compliance, required services, price, latency, then design multi-AZ for HA.
conceptCards.example: Latency-based routing to nearest healthy Region with warm standby

conceptCards.title: Global routing
conceptCards.summary: Route 53 picks healthy endpoints. CloudFront terminates TLS at edge and caches safe content.
conceptCards.example: Failover record: primary ap-south-1 ALB, secondary eu-west-1 ALB
